review_type: AI-assisted desk source audit, not a human user study or phone/inventory verification
scope: All fifteen returned cards in D07-D12 from the single frozen 12-query campaign. No additional app requests made.
rubric_notes: Dish-level flavor evidence required; frying alone does not prove crispy texture.
Municipal city is strict; metro-area exceptions are noted but not silently accepted.
Fresh-and-light is a menu-description or salad/raw/steamed-style proxy, not assurance of actual freshness, safety or nutrition.
Description-as-title is a presentation defect; semantic dish support can pass only when the corresponding item is unambiguous.
Operational judgments were applied after generation and are not a blinded, preregistered human annotation protocol.
Active public merchant pages/menus support venue identity; current operating status was not verified by telephone or field visit.
